say:2:1130908001:1.text: The ones up ahead are attacking anyone in sight!
say:2:1130908001:1.source_cn: 前面那些陆行鸟，一看到人就开始攻击！

say:3:1130908002:1.text: Terrabirds have always been known for their docile nature; I've even petted a few back in Alkali! What's gotten into them lately?
say:3:1130908002:1.source_cn: 它们一向是以性格温顺著称的，我前几次来咸水镇的时候还摸...

say:4:1130908003:1.text: They nearly pecked my head off! I wouldn't have gone near those crazy birds if you hadn't assured me that it was perfectly safe! It's all your fault!
say:4:1130908003:1.source_cn: 你还说呢！要不是你说它们不会伤害人，我也不会凑那么近观...

say:5:1130908004:1.text: If I wasn't a fast runner, I'd be terrabird food right now!
say:5:1130908004:1.source_cn: 幸亏我跑得快，不然就浑身都是伤了！

say:6:1130908005:1.text: How could I have possibly known they'd attack you?! Something strange must have happened to them—it's the only explanation!
say:6:1130908005:1.source_cn: 这我哪能提前预料到？肯定是发生了什么怪事，它们才会这样的。
